_nota: Le forme d'icona per tools/prompt_icone.py: en = il nome in inglese (in maiuscolo nel prompt), desc = com'è fatta, con [GREY] sulle parti del materiale (il gioco le colora). _salta = forme da non rifare.

zolla.desc: a chunky rounded cube of earth or stone, the WHOLE block [GREY] (NOT brown: neutral grey only), with soft cracks and a few small pebbles in it, two little roots poking out of its sides (plum wood) and a small tuft of moss on top (leaf green)

ciotola.desc: a round wooden bowl (plum wood) seen from slightly above, full of a hearty stew or soup [GREY] with a few chunks and a sprig of herbs (leaf green) on top, a little steam curl

essenza.desc: a small floating orb of magical essence [GREY] like a swirling drop of liquid light, with a bright core and a few sparkling motes orbiting it

arco.desc: a curved bow drawn DIAGONALLY, its limbs [GREY] shaped like a bent branch with leaf-shaped tips, a leather grip in the middle (warm leather), a thin taut string

lancia.desc: a long spear drawn DIAGONALLY: a straight shaft of root wood (plum wood) wrapped with a leaf binding (leaf green) near the head, and a long leaf-shaped blade [GREY] at the top end

seta.desc: a neat skein / bundle of fine silk thread [GREY], wound in soft loops and tied with a small band (warm leather), one loose thread curling out

spada.desc: a one-handed sword drawn DIAGONALLY: a straight leaf-shaped blade [GREY] with a central ridge, a small curved crossguard [GREY], a grip wrapped in leather (warm leather) and a round pommel with a tiny turquoise sap bead

balestra.desc: a crossbow drawn DIAGONALLY: a wooden stock (plum wood), a short curved bow [GREY] across the front, a loaded bolt with a [GREY] tip, a small trigger

mantello.desc: a long flowing cloak [GREY] hanging as if worn by an invisible person, with a high collar and soft folds, fastened by a round clasp (amber)

frusta.desc: a whip coiled in loops: a long braided lash [GREY] ending in a thin tip, attached to a short handle of root wood (plum wood) wrapped in leather (warm leather)

spadone.desc: a huge two-handed greatsword drawn DIAGONALLY: a very wide long blade [GREY] with a notch near the guard, a broad crossguard [GREY], a long grip wrapped in leather (warm leather)

mazza.desc: a heavy war hammer drawn DIAGONALLY: a big blocky hammer head [GREY] with one flat face and one short spike, on a sturdy handle of root wood (plum wood) with a leather grip (warm leather)

tavoletta.desc: an upright rounded stone tablet [GREY] slightly tilted, carved with a few glowing turquoise sap runes (#5ff0e0), a chipped corner and a little root (plum wood) curling around its base

scaglia.desc: a large single curved scale or flake [GREY] shaped like a rounded shield-leaf, with fine growth ridges, a glossy highlight and a sharp tip

pugnale.desc: a short dagger drawn DIAGONALLY: a narrow thorn-shaped blade [GREY], a tiny curved guard [GREY], a short leather-wrapped grip (warm leather) and a small amber pommel

virgulto.desc: a young living branch drawn DIAGONALLY: a slender twig [GREY] with two or three fresh leaves (leaf green) and a tiny glowing sap bud (turquoise) at the tip

penna.desc: a single long feather drawn DIAGONALLY [GREY], with soft barbs, a few separated strands and a thin central quill

falcione.desc: a long curved falchion / scythe-sword drawn DIAGONALLY: a wide crescent blade [GREY] curving like a moon, a leather-wrapped handle (warm leather) and a small root-shaped guard (plum wood)

verga.desc: a magic staff drawn DIAGONALLY: a twisted shaft of root wood (plum wood) whose top splits into curling roots holding a round crystal orb [GREY] that glows softly

stivali.desc: a pair of sturdy boots seen from the side, one slightly behind the other [GREY], with folded cuffs, laces and a thick sole of root wood (plum wood)

scettro.desc: a short ornate sceptre drawn DIAGONALLY: a root-wood handle (plum wood) topped by a crown-like head [GREY] of three curling prongs cradling a small glowing amber gem

girandola.desc: a curved boomerang shaped like a bent seed-wing [GREY], seen flat, with a leather wrap (warm leather) at the elbow and two small motion curls

piccone.desc: a pickaxe drawn DIAGONALLY: a handle of root wood (plum wood) with a leaf binding (leaf green), and a curved double-pointed pick head [GREY] across the top

guanti.desc: a pair of work gloves [GREY] one overlapping the other, with stitched seams, a cuff strap (warm leather) and slightly curled fingers

ascia.desc: a woodcutter's axe drawn DIAGONALLY: a handle of root wood (plum wood) with a leather grip (warm leather), and a broad curved leaf-shaped axe head [GREY] on one side of the top

tomo.desc: a thick closed spell book seen slightly from the front, its cover [GREY] with embossed root patterns and metal corners [GREY], a glowing turquoise sap rune on the cover, a leather spine (warm leather) and a ribbon bookmark (leaf green)

trivella.desc: a big hand drill drawn DIAGONALLY: a spiral auger bit [GREY] like a twisted horn pointing up-right, mounted on a root-wood crank handle (plum wood) with a leather grip (warm leather)

flauto.desc: a wooden pan-pipe / flute drawn DIAGONALLY: a slender pipe [GREY] with finger holes, bound with a leaf binding (leaf green), a small leaf dangling from a cord

semebomba.desc: a round explosive seed pod [GREY] with ridged husk segments, a short curly fuse of dry root (plum wood) on top with a little amber spark

canna.desc: a fishing rod drawn DIAGONALLY: a long flexible rod [GREY] with a small reel near the leather grip (warm leather), a thin line curving down to a small hook and an amber bobber

artiglio.desc: a big curved beast claw [GREY], hooked and sharp, with a rough base where it joined the paw and a couple of growth lines

lingotto.desc: a metal ingot [GREY] shaped like a plump seed or almond, lying on its side, with bevelled edges, a stamped leaf mark on top and a bright metallic highlight

pesce.desc: a whole fish seen from the side facing right [GREY], with fins, scales, a curved tail and a round eye; mouth slightly open

vasetto.desc: a small glass jar [GREY] with a cork stopper (plum wood) tied with string, a soft glow of turquoise sap inside and a highlight on the glass

goccia.desc: a single big glossy liquid drop [GREY], teardrop shaped, with a bright highlight and a little splash ring at its base

scrigno.desc: a small treasure chest seen from a 3/4 front view, its body of root wood (plum wood), the metal bands, corners and lock [GREY], the lid slightly domed
